map.售价 = 80 × (1 + 25%) = 100 元；单位毛利 = 100 −: Price = 80 × (1 + 25%) = 100 CNY; unit gross profit = 100 - 80 = 20 CNY; gross margin = 20/100 = 20.0%.
map.销量 = 固定成本 ÷ 单位毛利 = 2000 ÷ 20 = 100 件（卖满:
Volume = fixed cost ÷ unit gross profit = 2,000 ÷ 20 = 100 units (must sell 100 to cover fixed cost).
Switching to 'target profit' mode with target profit 2,000 and volume 100 gives price = 80 + (2,000+2,000)/100 = 120 CNY.
map.四种定价策略分别怎么用？: How to use the four pricing strategies?
map.成本加成最稳妥；目标利润保证回本；竞品参照适合红海；价值定价适合差异化/高感知价: Cost-plus is safest; target-profit guarantees payback; competitor-reference suits red oceans; value pricing suits differentiated/high-perceived-value products. Compare suggested price and margin on the same screen.
map.盈亏平衡销量怎么来的？: Where does break-even volume come from?
